HISTORY OF STUDENT GROWTH IN INDIANA

• Started under Wes Bruce in 2008 with the Rooney Foundation.

• Included the calculation of student growth percentiles and student
growth projections.

• Due to feedback from eld that they wanted to know in advance
what their growth goal was, Indiana began providing scale score
targets for typical and higher growth a year in advance.

• This “rolling baseline” approach to student growth is currently
implemented in the Indiana waiver.

2014-2015 STUDENT GROWTH IN INDIANA
• This “rolling baseline” approach to student growth is currently
implemented in the Indiana waiver.

• Previously projections were made from the current year and used
the following.

• With the assessment transition, projections couldn’t be made
from last year (2013-2014) to this year (2014-2015) because a
new test was being implemented.

• With the data available we link (equate) the current test to last
year’s test and go back and create projections like we would have.
